单据文旅旧文识别，未取得独立文保编号或当前内部开放资料。\n当前仅有文旅旧文的身.en: Identified solely from an old tourism and culture article; no independent cultural-heritage registration number or current interior-access materials have been obtained. At present, only identity and location clues from the old tourism and culture article are available; no independent cultural-heritage registration number, current-condition verification, or interior-access materials have been obtained.

园林与其宅院合为一条；来源所列地址范围不同，保留各自口径，内部开放未核实。\n不.en: The garden and its residence are combined into one entry; sources give different address ranges, which are retained according to their respective standards, and interior access has not been verified. Sources describe the scope of the residence differently: cultural-heritage materials list Keyuan and No. 5 Mao'er Hutong separately, while other introductions use the range Nos. 7–15; interior access has not been verified.

公开街面观察院门；不将私人或未开放宅院记成可以入内。\n资料确认院址、历史沿革及.en: The gate was observed from the publicly accessible street frontage; private or unopened residences are not recorded as enterable. The materials confirm the address, historical development, and cultural-heritage status; the visiting scope can only be based on the old article’s wording “the outside and the gate,” and the current access status has not been verified.

本条为雨儿胡同13号，不是跨车胡同13号的另一处齐白石故居。\n本条仅对应雨儿胡.en: This entry concerns No. 13 Yuer Hutong, not another former residence of Qi Baishi at No. 13 Kuache Hutong. This entry corresponds only to the courtyard at No. 13 Yuer Hutong and does not extend to other former residences of Qi Baishi; current opening hours and conditions for interior visits have not been verified.

故居建筑、原状陈列合为一处，不把未取得单件身份的用品拆为独立藏品。\n来源对展陈.en: The former-residence building and its period-style display are combined as one site; objects without individually established identities are not divided into independent collection items. The source describes the exhibition and preservation of the original state, but does not provide the current opening hours or reservation requirements needed for this entry.

同一宅院的不同时期名称合并；历史使用不代表当前室内开放。\n历史来源对宅院原主人.en: Different names used for the same residence in different periods are combined; historical use does not indicate current interior access. Historical sources record the former owner of the residence, its period as a temporary headquarters, and subsequent uses; they do not provide information on the current preservation of the building, interior access, or visiting conditions.

先按文旅旧文识别同一宅院组，原有花园与建筑保存情况待补专门文保材料。\n来源表述.en: The same residential complex was first identified based on an old tourism and culture article; the preservation of the original garden and buildings awaits supplementary specialized cultural-heritage materials. The source describes it as “the residence of Ronglu’s father” and does not directly call it Ronglu’s own residence; the preservation of the original garden and buildings awaits verification through specialized cultural-heritage materials, and access status has not been inferred from surrounding information.

原文只支持历史宅主归属；当前建筑用途和内部开放未核实。\n仅据该条文旅旧文整理历.en: The original text supports only the historical attribution of the residence’s owner; the current building use and interior access have not been verified. The historical identity has been compiled solely from the old tourism and culture article for this entry; address, surrounding scenic areas, and transportation information are not treated as interior information about the residence, and current access conditions have not been verified.

原文只支持历史宅主归属；不把校园或居民院落默认当作旅游开放场所。\n原文使用“曾.en: The original text supports only the historical attribution of the residence’s owner; a campus or residential courtyard is not automatically treated as a tourism venue open to visitors. The original text uses the expression “was once” for the historical attribution and does not state whether it still exists or is open today; information about surrounding campuses and residential courtyards is not applied to this subject.

历史归属仅据本轮取得的文旅旧文，未独立核对产权沿革；名称明确标示来源归属。\n名.en: The historical attribution is based solely on the old tourism and culture article obtained in this round, and the ownership history has not been independently checked; the name explicitly indicates the source of the attribution. The attribution of the residence’s owner in the name is explicitly identified as what the tourism and culture materials call it; the ownership history has not yet been independently checked against the materials obtained in this round. Historical records do not equal current-condition or access information.

按文保工程资料的正式身份记载，不自行增添宅主归属；室内开放未核实。\n资料为20.en: The formal identity recorded in the cultural-heritage conservation project materials is followed, without independently adding an attribution to a residence owner; interior access has not been verified. The material is a 2015 tender notice for a lightning-protection project and supports only the cultural-heritage identity, approximate scale, and project matters at that time; it does not specify the current building condition, use, or interior access.

现代有机更新项目，不写成全为明清原构；居民建筑不默认可入内。\n这是现代更新项目.en: This is a modern organic-renewal project and is not described as consisting entirely of original Ming- and Qing-dynasty structures; residential buildings are not automatically treated as enterable. This is a modern renewal project, and the existing buildings cannot therefore all be regarded as original Ming- and Qing-dynasty structures; the source also records that it received the Asian Architecture Gold Award in 1992 and the World Habitat Award in 1993, but current access has not been inferred from this.

来源明确旧建筑已拆除；作为历史原址与校园外观记录，不作现存靳宅原构。\n来源明确.en: The source clearly states that the old buildings have been demolished; this is recorded as a historical site and a record of the campus exterior, not as surviving original structures of the Jin residence. The source clearly states that all the old buildings were demolished; the existing campus buildings cannot be described as original structures of the Jin residence, and campus visiting or access arrangements have not been verified.

前海、后海、西海与沿岸古迹组成的整体；北海公园独立，不并入本清单。\n不同来源对.en: The whole comprises Qianhai, Houhai, Xihai, and the historic sites along their shores; Beihai Park is independent and is not included in this list. Different sources emphasize different aspects of the scope: historical and gazetteer materials emphasize the three lakes, the water system, and shoreline improvements, while tourism and culture materials emphasize historic sites and residences along the shores and the status of the protected area; this entry does not include Beihai Park and does not use access information for individual shoreline attractions as a proxy for the status of the scenic area as a whole.

水域与所属风景区重叠，不按多个整体重复累计参观用时。\n本条资料主要来自什刹海整.en: The water area overlaps with the scenic area to which it belongs and is not counted repeatedly as multiple overall sites for visiting time. The materials for this entry mainly come from an overall introduction to Shichahai and do not provide independent information on Qianhai’s area, boundaries, current access arrangements, or separate visiting duration; the current condition of facilities is not inferred from this.

水域与所属风景区重叠，不按多个整体重复累计参观用时。\n资料把后海置于什刹海整体.en: The water area overlaps with the scenic area to which it belongs and is not counted repeatedly as multiple overall sites for visiting time. The materials place Houhai within the overall narrative of Shichahai and do not give Houhai’s independent area, boundaries, current opening hours, or current conditions for water activities; historical reports are not treated as commitments about the present condition.

水域与所属风景区重叠，不按多个整体重复累计参观用时。\n本条缺少西海独立的水域面.en: The water area overlaps with the scenic area to which it belongs and is not counted repeatedly as multiple overall sites for visiting time. This entry lacks independent information on Xihai’s water area, boundaries, current opening hours, and facility preservation; the descriptions of “restoration” and functions belong to the cited historical reports and cannot directly be treated as current conditions.

桥体与“银锭观山”视廊合为一个参观点；能否观山受天气和能见度影响。\n现有来源重.en:
The bridge and the “Silver Ingot Viewing Mountain” scenic corridor are treated as one viewing point; mountain views depend on weather and visibility.
Existing sources focus on the scenic corridor and sightseeing routes and do not specify the bridge’s construction date, structural dimensions, protection status, or independent opening rules; the viewing effects described in reports do not mean they can be achieved under all weather conditions.

闸桥合一，与德胜门箭楼为不同对象；保留1919年桥面改造等历史信息，不当作当前通.en:
The sluice and bridge are integrated and are a different object from the Deshengmen Barbican; historical information such as the 1919 bridge-deck renovation is retained and is not treated as the current traffic status.
Sources clearly record historical renovations but do not provide information on the bridge’s current condition, current traffic management, or opening hours; route articles merely list it as a sightseeing stop.

桥与其水闸遗产关系保留，不把石桥现存构件笼统全称为元代原物。\n不同来源对始建及.en:
The relationship between the bridge and its sluice heritage is retained; the existing stone-bridge components are not broadly described as original Yuan dynasty objects.
Different sources emphasize different aspects of the initial construction and renovations, all of which are retained; the bridge’s historical evolution does not mean that all existing components are original Yuan dynasty objects. No current opening or traffic arrangements are inferred from this.

组合石刻记录，原文明确不同位置和年代，不把六只全部称为元代原物；民俗寓意不是实际.en:
A combined record of stone carvings: the original text clearly specifies different locations and dates, and does not describe all six as original Yuan dynasty objects; folk symbolism is not actual flood-control functionality.
The specific dates of the six stone beasts are not the same, and the sources clearly identify only one of them as a Yuan dynasty stone carving; this entry does not describe the group of carvings as a whole as original Yuan dynasty objects, nor does it treat legends as an engineering function.

历史市集与当代商业街区分别描述；不将旧文店铺名录当作当前营业承诺。\n历史市集沿.en:
The historical market and the contemporary commercial district are described separately; an old shop directory is not treated as a current promise that the shops are operating.
The market’s historical development and its contemporary commercial positioning come separately from the same old official article; the material does not specify current business hours, shop listings, or real-time operating status.

街道整体与广福观有包含关系，不把商店逐一当作文物景点。\n本条概述街道整体；商店.en:
The street as a whole and Guangfu Temple have an inclusion relationship; the shops are not treated individually as heritage attractions.
This entry provides an overview of the street as a whole; the shops are mentioned only as a general summary of the street’s commercial culture and are not listed individually as attractions. The source’s statement that it is the “oldest” is promotional wording from the original text and has not been independently assessed.

历史宫观与现文化展示中心合并一条，展览内容与开放安排需按发布年份理解。\n历史宫.en:
The historical palace-temple complex and the current Cultural Exhibition Center are combined into one entry; exhibition content and opening arrangements should be understood according to the publication year.
The historical palace-temple complex and the current Cultural Exhibition Center are described together. The exhibitions and activities are reported in 2023 and should not be taken to indicate current arrangements; a 2026 webpage states that it is currently used as an exhibition center.

唐代始建在区政府资料中写作据传，保留限定；当前来源中纪年文字差错留给审计核对。\.en:
The statement that it was supposedly founded in the Tang dynasty is retained as written in district-government materials; the chronological wording errors in the current sources are left for audit review.
“Supposedly founded” is retained according to the district-government materials. One source gives the Qing renovation year as “the 214th year of the Qianlong reign (1759),” while another district-government source gives it as “the 24th year of the Qianlong reign (1759)”; both wordings are retained side by side without correcting the original text. Opening to the public refers to the post-renovation status stated by the source and does not constitute confirmation of current opening.

宗教场所，文物介绍与当日宗教活动、公众进入安排分开。\n本条只介绍广化寺建筑、沿.en:
A religious site; the heritage description is kept separate from religious activities on the day and arrangements for public entry.
This entry only describes Guanghua Temple’s architecture, history, and historical uses. The attached sources do not provide information about religious activities, opening on a particular day, or public entry, so these cannot be inferred.

同一地点的祠与纪念馆合并；保留旧展陈与新展陈来源日期，不强行拼成当前展厅目录；现.en:
The shrine and memorial hall at the same location are combined; the dates of the sources for the old and new exhibitions are retained, without forcibly combining them into a current gallery directory; the current building includes a reconstruction on the original site.
Huitong Shrine and the memorial hall are combined as the same location. The four-gallery and five-gallery descriptions come respectively from sources dated 2025 and 2023 and are not forcibly merged; the 2025 source indicates that the site may be temporarily closed because of renovation, exhibition installation, or expansion, so visitors should inquire before visiting.

作为西海沿岸湿地游览空间，与西海水域有包含及相邻关系。\n本条仅介绍西海湿地公园.en:
A wetland sightseeing space along the western shore of Xihai, with an inclusion and adjacency relationship to the waters of Xihai.
This entry only describes Xihai Wetland Park as a sightseeing space along the shore; the Yuan-dynasty pier, Huitong Shrine, and memorial hall are included as related background and do not represent information about the park itself. No clear information is available on its current opening status.

资料仅说明临岸雕像，不编造作者、尺寸或坐标。\n本条仅概述雕像本体；湿地、公园、.en:
The material only describes a waterside statue; no creator, dimensions, or coordinates are fabricated.
This entry only provides an overview of the statue itself; the wetland, park, Huitong Shrine, and Grand Canal are included only for location and background and are not treated as information about the statue’s own dimensions, architecture, or opening status.

郭沫若故居与纪念馆同一对象，院落、原状陈列合为一个参观点。\n郭沫若故居与纪念馆.en:
The former residence and memorial hall of Guo Moruo are the same object, with the courtyard and original-state displays treated as one viewing point.
The former residence and memorial hall of Guo Moruo are organized as the same object. Regarding the history of the early courtyard, official sources respectively use the wording “a component of Prince Gong’s Mansion” and “a part of the Prince Gong’s Mansion property”; both are retained as source information. Current admission fees are not inferred from historical ticket prices.

西花园改作故居，不将整个醇亲王府都称为对外开放的宋庆龄故居。\n本条仅指醇亲王府.en:
The Western Garden was converted into a former residence; the whole Prince Chun’s Mansion is not described as the former residence of Soong Ching Ling open to the public.
This entry refers only to the former residence of Soong Ching Ling converted from the Western Garden of Prince Chun’s Mansion and does not describe the entire Northern Mansion as the former residence. Sources differ somewhat in their statements about the naming date and “remaining open to this day”; current opening status is not inferred from them.

本条指后海北府，不是鲍家街南府；与西花园宋庆龄故居有包含关系，王府其他部分开放未.en:
This entry refers to the Northern Mansion at Houhai, not the Southern Mansion on Baojia Street; it has an inclusion relationship with the Soong Ching Ling former residence in the Western Garden, while the opening of other parts of the mansion has not been verified.
This entry only organizes information on the Northern Mansion at Houhai and does not concern Prince Chun’s Southern Mansion. Sources explain the relationship between the Western Garden and the former residence of Soong Ching Ling but do not verify whether the other parts of the mansion are currently open to the public.

不是恭王府，亦不是天津庆王府；来源历史纪年口径不一致，保留待审；内部开放未核实。.en:
It is not Prince Gong’s Mansion and not the Qing Prince Qing’s Mansion in Tianjin; historical dating differs among sources and is retained for review; internal opening has not been verified.
Sources differ regarding the first year of the Xianfeng reign, reconstruction during the Guangxu reign, and the year of ennoblement; all are retained without revision. The material does not verify arrangements for entry inside.

府邸与后来的学校功能分别记录，部分建筑拆改，不默认校园允许游客进入。\n本条同时.en:
The residence and its later school use are recorded separately; some buildings were demolished or altered, and visitor access to the campus is not assumed.
This entry records both the residence’s history and its subsequent use as a school; the surviving campus buildings are not treated as the complete princely residence, nor is entry for visits inferred from historical materials.

主楼与涛贝勒府原花园、马厩存在历史用地关系，建筑时代和身份分别说明；入校安排未核.en:
The main building has a historical land-use relationship with the former garden and stables of Prince Tao’s Mansion; the building period and identity are explained separately; school-entry arrangements have not been verified.
This entry is limited to the main building on Dingfu Street and its historical land-use relationship and does not treat the garden, stables, or the existing campus of Prince Tao’s Mansion as part of this point. School entry and visiting arrangements have not been verified.

旧饭庄及其后续用途与当前餐饮营业无必然关系；不以历史名店介绍承诺现营业。\n资料.en:
The former restaurant and its subsequent uses do not necessarily relate to current restaurant operations; a historical famous-restaurant description is not treated as confirmation that it is currently operating.
The material only describes the restaurant historically and its later use as an alumni building and cannot confirm that it is currently a dining establishment or still operating.

历史祭祀建筑与现存文物身份照录；公众入内安排未核实。\n本条按来源保留其由醇贤亲.en:
The historical sacrificial building and its current heritage status are transcribed as recorded; public entry arrangements have not been verified.
This entry retains, according to the sources, the change in identity from the Temple of Prince Chunxian to Guanyue Temple; public entry and current use have not been verified.

临后海的街巷空间，与沿线广化寺、名人旧居有关系，居民院落不默认可入内。\n本条介.en:
A lane space beside Houhai, related to Guanghua Temple and former residences of notable figures along the route; access to residential courtyards is not assumed.
This entry describes the lane as a whole and does not treat Guanghua Temple, the former residence of Soong Ching Ling, or residential courtyards along the route as information about internal points of Yandai Xiejie; access to residential courtyards is not assumed.

什刹海北缘衔接点，箭楼与原城门整体区分；当前内部开放未核实。\n本条仅据来源概述.en:
A connecting point on the northern edge of Shichahai, with the barbican distinguished from the former city gate as a whole; current internal opening has not been verified.
This entry only provides an overview of the barbican itself based on the sources; the sources do not state its current internal opening status, which therefore cannot be inferred.

什刹海西南周边延伸点，与湖岸核心区分列；旧文居住起始年份待复核。\n“1950年.en:
An extension point around the southwest of Shichahai, listed separately from the lakefront core; the starting year of residence in the old article requires further review.
“Moved in in 1950” and “the last ten years of his life” come from different official materials and have not been uniformly corrected; historical opening information does not represent the current opening status.

整体与其府邸、花园节点重叠，不能把各节点用时累加成多次完整王府参观。\n本条概述.en:
The whole overlaps with its residence and garden points; the times spent at individual points cannot be added together as multiple complete visits to the princely residence.
This entry provides an overview of the residence and garden as a whole and does not double-count information on internal points; official sources differ on the length of the rear building, and the differing figures are retained separately. The opening hours in the source are webpage information and cannot confirm current opening.

区域衔接的报时建筑群整体；与两座建筑和钟鼓实物有包含关系。\n本条作为钟鼓楼建筑.en:
The architectural complex of time-telling buildings as a whole at the regional connection point; it has an inclusion relationship with the two buildings and the physical bells and drums.
This entry provides an overview of the Bell and Drum Towers architectural complex as a whole; specific information on the Bell Tower, Drum Tower, and physical bells and drums is provided in the corresponding entries and cannot be substituted for one another.

现存建筑、历史重建和更鼓复制陈列分别理解。\n本条区分历史建造、现存建筑和更鼓陈.en:
The existing building, historical reconstructions, and the reproduced display of the night-watch drum are understood separately.
This entry distinguishes historical construction, the existing building, and the display of the night-watch drum; the sources record reconstruction during both the Jiaqing and Guangxu reigns of the Qing dynasty, without further determining how each construction project corresponds to the surviving parts.

元代始建与清代现存建筑不是同一建造阶段；不把整楼写成元代原构。\n元代始建、明代.en:
The Yuan-dynasty initial construction and the existing Qing-dynasty building do not belong to the same construction phase; the entire tower is not described as an original Yuan-dynasty structure.
The Yuan-dynasty initial construction, Ming-dynasty reconstruction, and existing Qing-dynasty building belong to different phases; the year of the Qianlong reconstruction is presented separately according to different official sources and is not combined into a single conclusion.

铜钟与钟楼为不同层级，年代和材料不能相互替代。\n本条仅整理铜钟资料；来源未提供.en:
The bronze bell and the Bell Tower are different levels of reference; their dates and materials cannot be substituted for one another.
This entry only organizes information on the bronze bell; the sources do not provide separate information on its current display or opening arrangements, which cannot be inferred from information about the Bell Tower.

一面残存主鼓与25面复制更鼓的性质区别必须保留，不称全部为明清原物。\n本条严格.en:
The distinction between one surviving main drum and 25 reproduced night-watch drums must be retained; they are not all described as original Ming- or Qing-dynasty objects.
This entry strictly distinguishes the surviving main drum from the reproduced night-watch drums; the sources do not specify the main drum’s exact date, material, or current display details, so no additional inference is made.

为鸦儿胡同6号院内的小楼；未取得当前公众进入安排，不将居民院落默认当作可入内。\.en:
A small building within Courtyard No. 6 of Yandai Xiejie; current public-entry arrangements have not been obtained, and the residential courtyard is not assumed to be open for entry.
This entry is organized solely from information on the small building within Courtyard No. 6 of Yandai Xiejie; the sources do not provide current public-entry arrangements, so entry cannot be inferred.

本条是德胜桥一桥两庙中的真武庙，不与德胜门箭楼内同名场所混为一处；活化计划不等于.en:
This entry concerns the Zhenwu Temple among the two temples at Desheng Bridge, not the identically named site inside the Deshengmen Barbican; the activation plan does not mean it has already opened.
This only provides an overview of the Zhenwu Temple beside Desheng Bridge and does not concern the identically named site inside the Deshengmen Barbican. The source page dates appear in abbreviated formats such as “24-10-31 11:27,” which are retained as written to reflect the source status; the activation and utilization plan is not equivalent to current opening.

2024年公布活化利用计划，后续报道仍记保护修缮，不据此判定当前对外开放。\n本.en:
An activation and utilization plan was announced in 2024, while subsequent reports still record conservation and renovation; current opening to the public is not determined from this.
This entry only organizes information on Yongquan Nunnery itself and its direct relationship with Desheng Bridge and Zhenwu Temple and does not treat the activation and utilization plan as evidence that it has opened. The date text in the body of the source sh_temple_renewal appears as “0-31 11:27,” an anomaly in the official old webpage text, and has not been rewritten.

花园为恭王府整体的一部分，与花园各节点有包含关系。\n本条概述花园整体，不拆述福.en:
The garden is part of the Prince Gong’s Mansion complex as a whole and has an inclusion relationship with the garden’s individual points.
This entry provides an overview of the garden as a whole and does not separately describe specialized information on internal points such as the Fuhua Stele, Western Gate, or Grand Theatre; the name and area follow the wording of the cited official source.

官网所列恭王府组成节点，建筑原构、复建或陈列依据原文分别说明；不从介绍页推导当日.en:
A listed component of the Prince Gong’s Mansion complex on the official website; the original structure, reconstruction, or display is explained separately according to the original text, and same-day indoor access or performances are not inferred from the introduction page.
The material only describes the architectural form, internal layout, and historical furnishings and does not specify current indoor opening, performances, or visiting conditions. The area is organized as 722 square meters according to the dedicated official page for this entry.

A listed component of the Prince Gong’s Mansion complex on the official website; the original structure, reconstruction, or display is explained separately according to the original text, and same-day indoor access or performances are not inferred from the introduction page.
This entry only organizes information about the Fuhua Stele itself inside Miyun Cave; the dimensions, inscription, and symbolism follow the wording of that official page, and no inference is made about current access to Miyun Cave or the possibility of viewing it at close range.

The components of Prince Gong's Mansion listed on the official website are described individually according to the source text as original structures, reconstructions, or bases for display; no inference is made from the introduction pages about whether interiors can be entered or performances are held on the day in question.
